rows.en: Nothing showed up in it

"Wh-what the hell is this?!"
Yoshioka suddenly shouted.
I looked in the mirror too, and it gave me a real shock.
There was a horrible face in the mirror.
A sinister face, like a demon's, you could say...
But, see, if you looked real close, it looked like Yoshioka.
What's more, when Yoshioka looked up, it looked up,
and when he talked, it opened its mouth.
Like that, it did everything Yoshioka did.
In other words, it was Yoshioka's own reflection in the mirror.
Though whether he ever realized that...
"That's weird. The book didn't say anything about this."
The way he was going on, I guess he hadn't realized.
"That's enough, isn't it? We saw something weird."
I said that for Yoshioka's sake, more or less.
Before he figured out that the thing in the mirror was himself, you know.
Well, I didn't want to see my own reflection either, so I wanted to get out of there fast.
...That's right, I got away without seeing myself in the mirror.
Between the bad angle and Yoshioka being in the way, well, I got lucky.
But in the end, Yoshioka didn't want to leave.
Fine, whatever.
If that's how he wanted it, he could suit himself.{p}

So I went home ahead of him.
Thinking about that mirror the whole way...
I remembered a rumor about a certain mirror.
It was the rumor of a mirror they call the Mirror of the Heart, a mirror that shows a person's true nature.
I don't know much about it, but it's supposed to be pretty big, and old.
If that was the mirror...
then Yoshioka's true nature is like a demon's, right?{p}

The next day, I went up to Yoshioka first thing in the morning.
"So what happened last night in the end?"
I asked him.
"I went home right after you did. The demon disappeared, see."
Yoshioka answered, just like that.
"The book said an angel would appear in that mirror, but I guess it was a load of nonsense after all."
An angel, huh. So that's why Yoshioka wouldn't leave back then.
If I'd heard that, I'd probably have waited a while longer myself.
It's because he keeps secrets like that, that his heart gets twisted and he ends up looking like a demon.
Get mixed up with a guy like that and you could end up in serious trouble, so after that I cut off all contact with Yoshioka.
Yoshioka stopped coming near me, too.
He looked at me with eyes that were clearly scared.{p}

Well, he must have seen my reflection in the mirror, so maybe he noticed my true nature?
He must have seen something pretty damn terrifying.
Not that I didn't see it coming.
...He said it, didn't he?
That the demon had disappeared.
When I left, the demon disappeared.
As for what that means...
Well, {a}?{p}Are you scared of me?
Yes
No

I see.
You're honest.
I wonder what your true nature looks like.
Well, if it bugs you, go check out the old school building.
Tell me when you do.
I'll come along with you.
Hey, it's fine, don't be shy.
But watch out if you see an angel.
Because an angel means death.
...There, that's the end of my story.
Who's up next?{p}

Yeah, I didn't go.
I mean, come on.
A door to the spirit world? Who'd believe that?
I got into bed and decided to just go to sleep.
But... I just couldn't sleep.
Whenever I closed my eyes, that leering grin of his kept popping into my head, over and over.
A human grin is a creepy thing, I tell you.
The corners of the eyes crinkle up, and the mouth goes all slack, right?
Behind my eyelids I kept seeing flashes of his teeth, and his tongue, the color of raw meat showing through a wound, and I just couldn't get to sleep.
I lay in my pitch-dark room, just listening to the clock.
That's when it happened.

Suddenly, I couldn't hear the clock anymore.
It felt like I'd wandered into some other world.
There was no sound.
I couldn't hear a thing.
I tried to open my eyes.
And then... my eyes wouldn't open either.
My eyes wouldn't open anymore.
But I could see.
Images were floating up on my eyelids.{p}

His face... Yoshioka's face.
This time he wasn't grinning.
His face was stiff, like he was tense.
And he looked me straight in the eye and said,
"Shindo..."
Yoshioka was holding a hand mirror, and he had it pointed at me.{p}...What would you do in a spot like that?
Try not to look in the mirror
Slap Yoshioka's hand away
Beg for my life
All I can do is dance

I decided to try not to look at the hand mirror.
But Yoshioka held it right up in front of my eyes, and... I saw it.
I saw myself reflected in Yoshioka's hand mirror.
My face... was twisted with fear.
I was ashamed to think I was making such a pathetic face, and I tried to turn away.
But I couldn't move.
My neck wouldn't move.
My body wouldn't move.
I was locked in sleep paralysis.
The image of Yoshioka on my eyelids just wouldn't go away.{p}

It felt a little different from dreaming.
It wasn't three-dimensional, like a dream.
It was like Yoshioka's image had been pasted flat onto my eyelids.
I wanted to peel that image of Yoshioka off, like picking off a half-dried scab.
...And then Yoshioka said something, like he could read my mind.
"Does it feel gross?
But it's your own fault.
Why didn't you come to the school?"
I apologized desperately.
My body wouldn't move and I couldn't make a sound, so in my head I begged Yoshioka to forgive me, over and over.
Seeing me like that seemed to put him in a good mood.
All smug, he started saying stuff like this.

"I'm at the mirror in the old school building right now.
I can see you in the facing mirrors.
This mirror wasn't a door to the spirit world.
It seems to be a mirror that can show people's hearts.
Apparently, you set up facing mirrors at 3:33 and 33 seconds in the middle of the night and picture the person whose heart you want to read.
I set up the mirrors thinking about you the whole time, since you never came, so I think that's how I got inside your mind just now."
Well, that was a relief, for the time being.
A minute ago Yoshioka had looked ready to curse me to death.
I'd half thought something had happened to him in the old school building and he'd come back to haunt me.{p}

After a while, Yoshioka's image slowly faded away.
"See you, Shindo.
This is just our little secret.
A mirror that can read people's hearts...
Don't you think that's really interesting?"
That's what he said.{p}

When I got to school the next day, Yoshioka was pale as a sheet.
I went to talk to him, to check whether the night before had been a dream or not.{p}

And then he... coughed up blood and collapsed.
Yoshioka was taken to the hospital.
So I decided to go check out that mirror in the old school building.
Was it really a mirror that could show people's hearts?{p}

When I went to the stairs leading to the third floor of the old school building, the mirror on the landing was there, same as before.
Had Yoshioka really come here last night?
Hadn't it all been a dream of mine?
With all sorts of questions running through my head, I went over every inch of the mirror on the landing.
And there, carved into the edge of the wooden frame, were these words:
'Cursed Mirror'
...It might have been somebody's prank.
But when I think about how Yoshioka coughed up blood and collapsed that day...
Maybe the reflection you see in facing mirrors isn't there for reading hearts, but for putting a curse on someone.
Maybe because Yoshioka didn't curse my reflection in the facing mirrors, the curse came down on him instead, and he collapsed.
That's the feeling I got.
That mirror really was a door to the spirit world.
A door to the spirit world of 'curses.'
...Don't you think so?{p}

Yoshioka hasn't been back to school since.
I haven't contacted his family.
I'm too scared to find out whether he's still alive...
...Well, that's the end of my story.
Who's going next?{p}

I got kind of scared and tried to knock his hand away.
But it was no good.
My body wouldn't move.
I was locked in sleep paralysis.
My face was reflected clear as day in Yoshioka's hand mirror...{p}

All I could do was dance!
That's what I thought.
Why did I think that?
.........I guess I was confused.
For starters, I decided to try the dance we did at last year's sports festival...
...Yeah, right. Like I'd ever do that.
Jeez, don't make me say weird stuff.
Are you even going to listen seriously?
Forget it, forget it.
I'm not telling you any more about this part.
Anyway, in the end, I did go to the school.
Yoshioka holding up that mirror was just a dream.
Even while I was thinking I can't sleep, I can't sleep, I must have drifted off at some point.
That dream got me kind of worried about Yoshioka, so I decided to head for the school.{p}

That's right, it came out.
A demon...
Hold on, what's with that look?
You don't believe me?
I'm not lying, so hear me out a little longer.
Out of one of all those mirrors in the facing mirrors, a demon appeared.
The demon had long hair hanging limp, and it looked like the corpse of a beautiful woman.
It stared hard at us, and the first thing out of its mouth was this:
"Hand... want to drink..."
Drink a hand?
You wouldn't get what that meant either, right?
While I was puzzling over it, Yoshioka suddenly came out with this:
"You want to drink... the blood from a hand?"
At that, the demon smiled sweetly.
I couldn't tell if I was scared or my heart was racing for some other reason; it was a weird feeling.
Then Yoshioka staggered toward the demon and held out his arm.{p}So what do you think I did?
Shouted at him to stop
Pulled Yoshioka by the arm

"Stop!"
I shouted as loud as I could.
But Yoshioka ignored me and held his arm out to the demon.
The demon happily took Yoshioka's hand, bowed its head, and gently kissed it... or so it looked.
That wasn't it.
It wasn't a kiss.
When the demon raised its face again, there was a thin trickle of blood at its mouth...
Yoshioka's hand had a wound on it, like it'd been bitten clean through.
The demon whispered,
"What do you desire in exchange for this blood?"
The demon was asking me.
Yoshioka was the one who let it drink his blood.
And yet the demon was asking me what I wanted.{p}And I...
First checked on Yoshioka
First said 'I want money'
First said 'I want a woman'
First, I checked whether Yoshioka was all right.{p}

"Yoshioka, you okay?"
No answer.
"Yoshioka...?"
Maybe he'd held out his arm under the demon's spell, and then fainted from the shock of having his blood sucked.
With that in mind, I reached for Yoshioka's arm.
And then...

He opened his eyes, said just one thing, and quietly closed them again.
And he never opened them again.
Get it? ...He was dead.
When the demon heard what Yoshioka said, it looked satisfied and vanished.
What Yoshioka said must have been his wish to the demon.
Yoshioka's arm lay flung out and limp, the color of something drained of blood.
It had sucked out... a huge amount of his blood.
The reason the demon asked me what I wanted was that Yoshioka was already dying.
Granting someone's wish in exchange for blood...
A demon like that was lurking in that mirror.{p}

I took off running.
I wanted to get out of the old school building as fast as I could...
The last wish Yoshioka spoke kept echoing in my head.
It was something I say a lot myself.
The wording might be different, but everybody thinks it at least once. I'm sure of that.
I don't know what Yoshioka meant by it.
But his wish was granted, all right.
It got me thinking.
If you go around thinking stuff like that without a second thought, can it call death down on you?{p}

What did he say as he was dying?
I'll tell you. You'd better be careful too.
Go around saying stuff like this, and the same thing might happen to you.
Yoshioka's last wish was this:
"I just want to rest..."
...That's the end of my story.
Whose turn is next?{p}

I pulled Yoshioka by the arm, trying to hold him back.
But I pulled too hard, and he stumbled and dropped the hand mirror he was holding...
This is a school in the middle of the night, right? The sound of that mirror shattering echoed all over the place, Yoshioka was shrieking, and my heart was pounding like crazy...{p}

We got out of the old school building and ran across the schoolyard.
The gravel getting into my shoes hurt, like my nerves were being needled over and over, and it felt really sickening.
Before long, we were outside the school gate.
And the moment we stepped out onto the road...!

...Before long, even more blood came gushing out of the wound on his hand, and he screamed over and over.
"Stop it! ...Stop it!"
The sight of it...
While Yoshioka was moaning, the car vanished, whoosh, just like the demon in the mirror.
It really did vanish.
Wasn't that car an illusion the demon showed us?
...The facing mirrors in the old school building seem to have been a ritual for summoning a demon.
In exchange for being summoned, the demon wanted Yoshioka's blood.
It showed us an illusion of a car and sucked the blood from Yoshioka's hand.
That's the only explanation I can think of.{p}

...Why did it want blood from his hand, you ask?
You don't know?
You've got a ring finger, right?
They say that's the finger closest to the heart.
That's why people wear wedding rings on the ring finger.
They make their vow on the finger closest to the heart.
In other words, the demon was drinking the blood running through the vein in his ring finger.
In place of blood from his heart...
Huh? What happened to Yoshioka after that?
Well...
He still comes to school every day, even now.
There's still a scar at the base of his ring finger, but it looks like his life was never in danger.
But he doesn't try to talk to me anymore.
Maybe he doesn't want to remember that day.
But I know something.{p}

Apparently, even now, he sometimes sets up facing mirrors at that mirror in the old school building.
And not just in the old school building, either; seems he's trying it in the restrooms and all kinds of other places.
I saw it once myself, and other guys in my class have caught him at it a few times too.
Here's what I think: didn't that demon leave Yoshioka completely bewitched?
Maybe he's thinking he wants to see it again or something.
And maybe this time he's thinking of getting some wish granted in exchange for his blood.
I just hope it doesn't suck his soul out.{p}

{a}, a seven wonders feature is all well and good...
But holding a gathering like this, you'd better watch out you don't get cursed by the fiends lurking in this school.
Take a look at your ring finger.
If you ever get hurt there from now on, it might mean a demon has its eye on you...
That's as far as my story goes.
Who's talking next?{p}

Like hell I did.
First, I checked whether Yoshioka was all right.{p}

{f:Is that what you'd say|Do you think I'd say that}?
Seriously, {f:are you that kind of guy|do you really mean that}?
First, I checked whether Yoshioka was all right.
Obviously, right?{p}

That's right.
The moment we set up the facing mirrors, I heard a nasty groan.
That groan... sounded like Yoshioka's voice.
No, it definitely was Yoshioka's voice.
After letting out that eerie groan, Yoshioka said this:

"Oh... ohh... wo-o-ow!
Wo-ow, th-this is amazing!
So when you face two mirrors, you get this many mirrors inside the mirror?"

.........
Without even thinking, I grabbed him by the scruff of the neck.
And then he goes,
"Aaaagh! A g-ghost! A ghost has me by the neck...!"
For the first time in my life, I wanted to strangle somebody.
Murderous intent...
You never know when or where it'll strike.
A feeling that visited an ordinary high school student for the very first time...!
That feeling was murderous intent.
.........Scary Stories from School.........The End.
.........
No, wait.
I'm not planning to end the story here.
What happened after this is the important part.
...What happened, you ask?{p}

Yeah, that's what I thought at the time.
"That's weird. This isn't supposed to happen..."
Yoshioka didn't seem convinced, but as far as I was concerned, it was like, well, that's rumors for you.

So I forgot all about that mirror right away.
But Yoshioka just couldn't let it go.
After that, it seems he kept sneaking into the old school building at night every so often to go look at that mirror.
But, sure enough, nothing happened.
If anything had, he'd have bragged to me about it for sure.{p}

Then one day, out of the blue, Yoshioka died.
It wasn't made public, but the cause of death was strange.
Old age.
Does a guy my age die of old age?
But at the funeral, when I saw his face, I had no choice but to accept it.
His whole face was covered in wrinkles, and his hair had gone completely white.
On top of that, they said even his internal organs couldn't have been anything but an old man's.
That's what the doctor said, so it must be true, right?
After the funeral, Yoshioka's mom handed me a letter.
Seems he wrote it right before he died.
It was short, written in shaky handwriting.
Don't look at that mirror.
It'll take your life.
...That's what it said.
That was all I needed.
I understood everything.{p}

Yoshioka died because that mirror sucked the life out of him.
I bet that's where the bit about a mirror leading to the spirit world comes from.
It took his whole lifespan, so he turned into an old man and died.
That 3:33 and 33 seconds in the middle of the night thing is involved, so it's probably not something that happens very often.
Still, I looked into that mirror once myself.
I figure it's taken a few years off my life.
So I'll just have as much fun as I can to make up for it.{p}

...{a}, right?
Point is, you can't brush off rumors.
This place is crawling with stories like this.
Just because a story's silly doesn't mean it's made up.
Be careful.
That's as far as my story goes.
Let's hurry on to the next one.{p}

You don't want to hear it?
...Are you really sure?
Why do you think I brought this up?
I'm telling you for your own good.
You'd better hear it.
Your face, see...{p}

What's with that face?
Fine, I won't tell you.
But be careful.
You never know when or where something might happen to you.
No matter how healthy you are now, there's no telling what kind of accident you might have...
Well, that's the end of my story.
Who's going next?{p}

Oh yeah?
You're tougher than you look.
That suits me fine; it just gives me more to look forward to.
From now on, I'm going to shove you all the way down into the depths of terror.
After all, my true nature is like a terrifying demon's.
If you're not scared of me, I think I've caught a glimpse of your true nature too.
Well, if it really bugs you, I'd recommend a trip to the old school building.
Even if your true nature turns out to be just what I think it is, there's nothing to cry about.
People are all pretty much the same.
That's the end of my story.
Let's move on.{p}

That's right.
Nothing showed up in it.
Not me, and not Yoshioka.
In the mirror, there was nothing but an endless row of facing mirrors, lined up one after another.
Yoshioka and I checked that we were each still there.
"Hey, can you see me?"
Like that.
Once we knew we were still there, the next problem was that we didn't know how long to keep the mirrors facing.
I had a feeling that if we broke them apart carelessly, we'd get cursed.
Seems Yoshioka felt the same way.
The two of us just stood there, locked in a staring contest with the mirror.
How much time went by, I don't know...{p}
For an instant, I thought the mirror wavered.{p}

And the next moment, our reflections were there, just like normal.
We were saved...
The witching hour had passed.
That's what I thought.
All we had to do now was take the mirrors apart and get out of there.
Just then...{p}

Maybe because he let his guard down, Yoshioka dropped the hand mirror.
The mirrors weren't facing anymore.
And at that same moment, our reflections faded right out of the mirror.
We'd been cursed, in other words.{p}

Ever since then, my reflection doesn't show up in mirrors.
Not just mirrors.
Glass, puddles, anything. It just doesn't show up.
I bet it's the same for Yoshioka.
He's been kind of a nervous wreck lately, and he hasn't been coming to school.
It doesn't bother me that much, but it's a real pain when I wash my face and stuff.
...You don't believe me?
Look at the window.
It's a little hard to make out, but you can see people's reflections in it, right?
See, there are only six.
Looks like you get it now.
They say people without a shadow don't live long.
Maybe I don't have that long either.
...Well, whatever.
I'll enjoy myself while I can.
That's the end of my story.
Who are you picking next?{p}
